#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class C2 {
private:
    static const string BAD;
    static const string STR;
    static const int INF = 1000000;

    string prepare(const string& s) {
        string res;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (BAD.find(c) != string::npos) {
                res.push_back(c);
            } else {
                res.push_back('A');
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    int fast(const string& s) {
        string t = prepare(s);
        int n = t.length();
        vector<int> a(n);
        vector<vector<int>> pos(3, vector<int>(n));
        vector<int> sz(3, 0);
        vector<vector<vector<int>>> cntHere(3, vector<vector<int>>(n, vector<int>(3, 0)));
        vector<vector<int>> pref(n + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = STR.find(t[i]);
            int c = a[i];
            cntHere[c][sz[c]] = pref[i];
            pos[c][sz[c]] = i;
            sz[c]++;
            pref[i + 1] = pref[i];
            pref[i + 1][c]++;
        }

        int sz0 = sz[0], sz1 = sz[1], sz2 = sz[2];
        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(2, vector<vector<vector<int>>>(sz0 + 1,
            vector<vector<int>>(sz1 + 1, vector<int>(sz2 + 1, INF))));

        dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;
        int ans = INF;

        for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz0; j0++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz1; j1++) {
                for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= sz2; j2++) {
                    for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                        int idx = j0 + j1 + j2;
                        int curVal = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
                        if (curVal == INF) continue;
                        if (idx == n) {
                            ans = min(ans, curVal);
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (j0 < sz0) {
                            int cost = max(j1 - cntHere[0][j0][1], 0) + max(j2 - cntHere[0][j0][2], 0);
                            dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2] = min(dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2], curVal + cost);
                        }
                        if (j1 < sz1 && last == 0) {
                            int cost = max(j0 - cntHere[1][j1][0], 0) + max(j2 - cntHere[1][j1][2], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2] = min(dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2], curVal + cost);
                        }
                        if (j2 < sz2) {
                            int cost = max(j0 - cntHere[2][j2][0], 0) + max(j1 - cntHere[2][j2][1], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1] = min(dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1], curVal + cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

public:
    void submit() {
        int dummy;
        cin >> dummy;
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        cout << fast(s) << endl;
    }
};

const string C2::BAD = "VK";
const string C2::STR = "VKA";

int main() {
    C2 c;
    c.submit();
    return 0;
}
